description: Harmonogramy přistavování velkokapacitních kontejnerů na území MČ Praha 12 is a dataset listed in Czech National Open Data Portal, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Městská část Praha 12. Schedules for the delivery of large-capacity containers in the territory of the City of Prague 12. Coverage: Městská část Praha 12. The portal shows the English title as "Schedules for the delivery of large-capacity containers in the territory of the City of Prague 12" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Městská část Praha 12. Its keywords include kontejnery, odpad, harmonogram. The listing shows 3 download or service links in CSV. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://data.gov.cz/zdroj/datové-sady/00231151/73e855ea1d81b87ac451b423bc480afc/distribuce/4b794ef49ab6cdd6515d6b16dcfa65ba/podmínky-užití). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-nkod-opendata-cz.
